reasons: Both correctly explain heap vs non-heap memory and give concrete fixes, including MaxRAMPercentage and a higher limit. B's main recommendation (keep 512m heap, raise the limit to 1Gi) is more coherent and its diagnostics (memory.current/memory.peak, checking for a leak between restarts) are more useful. A's 512Mi fallback adds its own flag caps up to about 608 MB, which is more than the limit, and it adds off-topic advice and an English 'Cost note' with speculative pricing.

A: Option 2 claims its flag set fits 'впритык' in 512Mi while its own sum (608 MB) exceeds the limit
Claims off-heap memory grows monotonically, which is an overgeneralization
B: Runs jcmd VM.native_memory summary without noting it requires -XX:NativeMemoryTracking to be enabled
